title: Installation.
officialText: Fire dampers, smoke dampers, combination fire/smoke dampers and ceiling radiation dampers located within air distribution and smoke control systems shall be installed in accordance with the requirements of this section, the New York City Mechanical Code, the manufacturer's installation instructions and damper’s listing.
